cases.input: Can we turn on SSO?: We are on the Business plan. Can we enable SAML single sign-on like we did last year?
cases.reply_excerpt: SAML single sign-on (SSO) and SCIM provisioning are included only in the Enterprise plan. Starter, Team, and Business plans do not include SSO. Business customers who need SSO must upgrade to Enterprise.

How do we verify webhook signatures?: What algorithm does the X-TaskFlow-Signature header use?
cases.reply_excerpt: Every delivery includes the header X-TaskFlow-Signature. Compute an HMAC-SHA256 of the raw request body with your endpoint secret and compare it with the header value using a constant-time comparison.

cases.input: Webhook signature header: How should our receiver check that a webhook really came from TaskFlow?
cases.reply_excerpt: The webhook delivery service was rewritten for higher throughput. Signature format and the X-TaskFlow-Signature header are unchanged.

cases.input: What is the API rate limit?: How many requests per minute can one token make?
cases.reply_excerpt: The REST API allows 600 requests per minute per token. Responses over the limit return HTTP 429 with the headers X-RateLimit-Remaining and Retry-After. Back off for the Retry-After interval before retrying.

cases.input: Change digest time: Can I change when the daily digest email arrives?
cases.reply_excerpt:
